major_concerns: Verifier expressivity and coverage not fully specified (may produce false negatives).
Task realism and selection criteria for 120 tasks need stronger justification to claim operational relevance.
Prompt and model-identification details are underspecified (affects replicateability).
Budget/pricing and API rate-limit contingencies not fully quantified.
Statistical power/sample-size rationale for paired tests not provided.
required_design_repairs: Pin exact LLM model identifiers, API versions, and deterministic generation settings (temperature, top_p, etc.).
Specify verifier tool, version, supported properties, and known limitations (e.g., Batfish version and capabilities).
Provide explicit task sourcing protocol, complexity labeling criteria, and examples; include holdout/seed rules.
Add formal sample-size/power calculation for the primary outcome and justify 120-task choice or adjust accordingly.
Define retry policy, random-seed control, prompt templates, and full prompt text to be frozen in preregistration.

major_concerns: Ethical risk of publishing usable adversarial/prompt-injection payloads and operational exploit details.
Ambiguity in how 'malicious directives' are detected and labeled (risk of subjective labeling).
Threat model and retrieval-system specifics (vector DB, retriever, provenance) are underspecified.
Potential for overclaiming generality beyond the specific retrieval/LLM setups tested.
required_design_repairs: Submit an explicit ethics/dual-use mitigation plan (redaction rules, high-level descriptions only, safe disclosure practices).
Define threat model precisely: attacker capabilities, access to retrieval index, example corruption methods, and limits.
Specify retrieval stack (vector DB, embedding model, FAISS/HNSW params) and how retrieval corruption is simulated.
Provide objective detection criteria for 'malicious directives' (e.g., pattern rules, validators) and inter-annotator agreement procedures.
Pin exact LLM identifiers, deterministic settings, and seeds; record API versions and any prompt-enrichment logic.

major_concerns: Adaptive-policy value estimates may be sensitive to assumptions in the cost/latency model (simulated scenarios may not reflect live variability).
Design relies on accurate marginal-gain estimation which may be brittle with limited data.
Policy-family baselines and hyperparameter choices (thresholds) are underspecified.
Potential complexity/engineering bugs in decision logic could bias results if not unit-tested.
required_design_repairs: Provide an explicit cost model with cited pricing sources, currency/date, and sensitivity ranges to be used in experiments.
Specify latency-measurement methodology used to parameterize simulations and include at least one real-measured latency regime.
Define adaptive-policy estimator details mathematically (features used, training procedure, if any) and baseline policy hyperparameters.
Add unit and integration test plans for policy orchestration and watchdog/timeouts; include reproducibility seeds and logging requirements.
Preregister decision thresholds and the stopping-rule family or provide a principled tuning protocol separate from primary outcome observation.

major_concerns: Reproducibility claim is fragile because public LLM APIs are nondeterministic and can change; achieving artifact-hash matches may be infeasible without deterministic model snapshots.
Licensing and privacy concerns for real-world network configs are not resolved; synthetic vs real data trade-offs need documentation.
Maintenance and dependency-locking for containerized verifier and CI are nontrivial and must be planned.
Risk that released attackable artifacts or configuration templates could be misused.
required_design_repairs: State explicit plan for achieving reproducibility given nondeterministic LLMs (e.g., store and publish generated outputs and hashes, use deterministic generation settings where possible, or provide offline model snapshots).
Document licensing for all dataset items and use synthetic augmentation where licensing forbids release; include privacy-preserving transformations and attestations.
Provide pinned container images with exact hashes for verifiers and CI scripts, and a maintenance/versioning plan for dependencies.
Include ethical-use guidance and acceptable-use terms; redact or abstract any sensitive configuration details that could enable misuse.
Define held-out subset reproduction protocol precisely (what will be matched, tolerance for nondeterminism, and how matching is measured).
